Well, we've missed those two injured men Jon and Lewis badly and in the mean time the throwers have strengthened their hold on the points table, taking over positions 1, 2 and 4. Nice work from hurdler Neil Owen - straight in at no. 5 and middle-distance man Rob Turner has shot up from 29 to no. 6.

A win might just have given us 3rd in the match but that was not considered a reality. 1500m-man Rob Turner was entrusted with leg one and he was followed by a really fired-up Darrell Maynard who ran a blinding leg to keep us in the hunt.

Elsewhere Steve Halliday and Rob Turner produced excellent 1500m times while Darrell Maynard suffered niggling injuries and never realised his potential (although he did gain a Welsh vest) and Dave Scott made a welcome return from his year's globetrotting.
Loughborough v WLI v London U. 1500m: 6, R.Turner 3:51.74. 110mH: 4, R.Hunter 15.28.
The best race was the 1500m with Rob Turner showing his new found confidence as he sat in and kicked into a strong headwind to win by 13/100ths.
